state.persona: Anonymous first-time visitor to dope.travel (a travel discovery site), on an iPhone-sized phone, no account, no prior knowledge of the product vocabulary. Wants to find a place worth going to, understand why and how far, and keep it for later.
state.job: Come back to the place they saved (Oktoberfest) a day later on the same phone.
state.workflow: Earlier they tapped 'Save this event' on the Munich page and it changed to 'Saved ✓' with the note 'Save and Watch stay on this device.' Now they open the site again.
state.navigation_visible: Bottom tab bar: World, Circles, People, Access, More. 'Trips' is only inside the More menu, listed as 'Trips — Saved, watched, and I'd go'.
state.trips_page: First screen: DOPE.TRAVEL / YOUR TRIPS. A place becomes a plan. Keep the places that stay with you. Glowing primary button 'Start a family ski trip ↗', then 'Open the trip designer', 'Preview a trip room ↓'. Saved places section is about 2.7 phone screens down, under a sample trip room gallery: 'YOUR TRAIL. The places you come back to. 01 Saved places 1' with one row: 'Oktoberfest' on the left and 'Save ↗' on the right (the whole row is a link to the event on the globe).

finds_within_30s.instructions: Probability the user finds their saved Oktoberfest within 30 seconds without help.

save_label.instructions: What does the user most likely think the 'Save ↗' label on the saved row means?

criteria.status: It is a label saying this item is a save
criteria.open: A link to open the saved item

keep_quality.instructions: How well does the product let a first-time visitor keep and re-find a place?
criteria: Poor: saved item is hard to find

legend.0: Poor: saved item is hard to find
